description: This file defines a React functional component 'Explore' for a frontend page that allows users to select a role and explore related roles based on adjacency data. It includes logic for loading roles from an API, fetching adjacency data from a Supabase database, and rendering a UI with role selection and adjacency table.

methods.name: Explore
methods.description: React functional component rendering the explore page for roles, includes state hooks, effects for data fetching, and UI rendering.
